_description: pubblici-esercizi-fipe-angem-ristorazione-collettiva level 4, 2026: Thirteenth month paid in December. Input packet for a payroll provider.

provenance.source: Input packet written for an independent payroll provider; the values are computed by ccnl-engine while no provider output exists.
provenance.independence: None yet: the values are an output of this engine, so the packet covers no output until a provider computes the same inputs.
provenance.anonymisation: Synthetic worker and employer: no personal data.
provenance.retention: Kept in the repository under its licence.

outputs.perimeter: Gross pay of the run: every earning of the run before contributions and taxes
INPS contributions withheld from the worker in the run
INPS contributions due by the employer for the run (INAIL excluded)
IRPEF and surtaxes withheld in the run net of refunds, before tax credits
Net pay of the run, before advances and deductions unrelated to payroll
TFR accrued in the run, kept by the employer or paid to a fund
Gross pay, employer contributions, TFR accrual and employer fund contributions of the run
